about: Each dealer's named trees (Jakob 2026-11-21: several trees per dealer, each with a name, about three at most; everything else is loose material that can later be deleted). A tree is a set of anchors from data/media-roles.json, by entry id: the root (A1) and the anchors it branches into, written in his notation by tools/dealer-tree.ts from the graph's nodes (IDLE = A1, READY = A2.1, READY-B = A2.2, READY-C = A2.3, a card node such as P4.C1 = A3P4C1). Films are not listed here: the tool finds every film whose first and last pictures are the tree's anchors. state: spelas (the game plays it), byggs (being made), vilar (resting). name is what Jakob sees and his to change. shares: the id of another tree of the same dealer whose anchors and films this one plays too; opening: a media-roles film outside the bank that leads into the root (the film before the game). An anchor may carry seat (1-7) when its picture is seen from that seat instead of the straight camera; the tool then writes S2-A2.2. seat is set only where a register says the angle. A tree is measured against his measure (src/dealer-trees.ts, 'en giv per kort'): 36 steps from its first A2.x anchor, the anchor at the shoe; its other A2.x anchors stand in for it where its own film is missing (the Casino gives P6C1 from A2.2). Read by tools/dealer-tree.ts, which writes its report to .runtime/dealer-trad/ and serves GET /api/trees to Karta.

trees.name: Pamela
trees.note: Pamela rests (Jakob 2026-11-12: nothing new is ordered for her). Her A3 level is read from the films' landing nodes; no single landing picture per card is chosen.

trees.name: Casino
trees.note: What the game plays today: the older hands. Every film of this tree was made from these pictures, and the tree keeps them, although Material calls paow-vila-ung-2 and paow-ankare-2-2-t1 ersatt (by the Tatuerad tree's A1 and A2.2).

trees.name: Ingången
trees.note: The way into the Casino through the film before the game (/trailer): the film ends on the Casino's A1 and the game goes on with the Casino's own films.

trees.name: Tatuerad
trees.note: The tattooed set (Jakob 2026-11-21): A1 paow-vila-tatuerad; A2.3 paow-ankare-2-3-d with two hands, the anchor at the shoe, her gaze down on the card (Jakob 2026-11-23 in Beslut: "Ja, byt blicken"); A2.2 paow-ankare-2-2-blick-a ("A2.2 ska vara som 2.1 fast med tatueringarna"). paow-ankare-2-3-c was the A2.3 until then, the same picture with her gaze to the side: it stays among the anchors, after the one that holds, so that the films that begin or end on it stay in the tree until they are remade (the first anchor given for a node is the node's picture). The A3 anchor for P4 is taken from the first deal of that earlier A2.3.
